title: Homogeneous representation of a balanced threshold function
statement: Let $g$ be a Boolean function on the $n$-dimensional sign cube. If $g$ is a linear threshold function and its real-valued version has mean zero, then there are real weights on the coordinates such that, at every input, $g$ equals the sign of the corresponding homogeneous linear form, with zero mapped to $+1$.
hypotheses_covered: $g$ is a Boolean function on the $n$-dimensional sign cube
The mean of its real-valued version is zero
